request_summary: Coordinate the read-only in-chat review of every feature file under src/api.

actions.description: Enumerated the nine API feature files, identified PowerShell, and captured their pre-review state.
Delegated the bounded read-only review to QA analyst using the Claude Sonnet 5 model declared in frontmatter.
Verified the reported accent, examples, and missing-tag findings and confirmed all requested feature files had no review-time changes.

outcome.detail: Direct source inspection confirmed the findings and the requested feature files remained unchanged.
